name: workel-mcp
description: Official Model Context Protocol server for Workel — a thin client of the Workel Public API v1
long_description: Exposes a Workel workspace to MCP-speaking AI clients (Claude, the OpenAI Agents SDK, or any other MCP-speaking client) as a small set of well-scoped, read-only tools covering projects, tasks, task comments, members, and events. Every rule that actually matters — what the configured API key can see, what it can write, how fast it can write it — lives in the Workel API itself; this extension holds no authority the key doesn't already have.

workel_api_key.title: Workel API key
workel_api_key.description: A Workel API key minted in Workel → Settings → Developers. Grant only the read:* scopes this server's tools use (read:projects, read:tasks, read:members, read:events) — see the package README's tool table for exactly which tool needs which scope. Never reuse a key another integration already holds.
